assumptions.description: Assumed selected analytical covariate law: age=20+59*Beta(1.45,1.8); female probability=.53+.001*(age-50). These are not PNS estimates or a claim of national representativeness. Equal-weight generated rows approximate the requested weighted complete-case distribution.

Assumed BMI=14+Gamma with conditional mean 26+.04*(age-50)+.6*female-.002*max(age-55,0)^2 and conditional SD4.5. This introduces age/sex dependence and right skew. The upper support is 200/(1.2^2), guaranteeing some weight/height pair within dictionary domains, but actual weight/height selection and pregnancy are not mechanistically reconstructed.

Assumed marginal-over-treatment conditional locations: SBP=125+.38*(age-50)+.32*max(age-50,0)+[-5+.10*(age-50)]*female+.7754*(BMI-25); DBP=80+.25*(age-50)-.43*max(age-55,0)-3*female+.5967*(BMI-25). Nonlinear age shapes and numeric sex contrasts are construction assumptions, not coefficients extracted from group means.

The two reported INTERSALT BMI coefficients are used unchanged as conditional location slopes per kg/m^2. This assumes transferable association despite country/era/age and richer covariate adjustment, inverse-variance pooling and target labweight selection. The final requested linear OLS coefficient may differ because of nonlinear age terms and conditioning; neither parameter is causal.

Assumed bivariate Student t residual with df8, unit-variance scaling, conditional Pearson correlation .50 and SD_S=13+.15*max(age-40,0), SD_D=9+.025*max(age-50,0). The .50 residual correlation is not derived from or relabelled from Beijing raw .545; both residual scales and tail law are assumptions. Common chi-square mixing creates tail dependence.

Target uses G-TECH MA100, three seated readings two minutes apart after >=5 minutes rest, with unverified released final averaging. INTERSALT uses two random-zero readings and Beijing two Omron readings. Net instrument, averaging, visit, selection and treatment differences are absorbed in the assumed surface and residual distribution; no separately estimated correction or untreated latent BP is claimed.

BP is generated conditional on each covariate row by rejection within SBP60-290, DBP30-200 and SBP>DBP. The first two bounds represent target analytical eligibility; positive pulse pressure is an additional physiology assumption. This is truncation by resampling, never clipping. It alters conditional moments and dependence near boundaries. BMI upper-bound rejection also truncates the assumed gamma law. No exclusion by hypertension, diabetes or therapy is added.

Beijing age>=65 target-row contrasts are approximate and differ in country, age support, sampling, treatment and BP protocol. Equal weights, complete-pair operators and sample SD ddof1 are explicit generated-data conventions. Source weighting and SD denominator are not fully reported. Strict unavailable checks stay unavailable; descriptive agreement is not source replay or target validation.

Exactly3000 rows, unique sequential IDs1..3000, NumPy default_rng(seed), full floating precision; maximum10000 rejection rounds then failure. These are task/computation settings, not biomedical evidence.

age_distribution.derivation: Assumed scaled-beta population law; not estimated from the target or sources.

female_probability.derivation: Assumed probability, ranging .50 to .559 over age20-79.

bmi_distribution.derivation: Assumed shifted gamma. Gamma shape=(conditional_mean-shift)^2/sd^2 and scale=sd^2/(conditional_mean-shift). Upper bound derives only from target dictionary200kg/1.2m squared.

sbp_location.derivation: All numeric location and age/sex parameters assumed. Older source group moments motivate allowing SBP and DBP age shapes to differ, without equating raw group contrasts to adjusted coefficients.

dbp_location.derivation: All numeric location and age/sex parameters assumed. Older source group moments motivate allowing SBP and DBP age shapes to differ, without equating raw group contrasts to adjusted coefficients.

bmi_sbp_slope.derivation: Reported source numeric coefficient per kg/m^2, used as a target conditional location coefficient under an explicit transport assumption. Five-unit source rescaling is multiplication by5.

bmi_dbp_slope.derivation: Reported source numeric coefficient per kg/m^2, used as a target conditional location coefficient under an explicit transport assumption. Five-unit source rescaling is multiplication by5.

residual_distribution.derivation: Entire residual law assumed. Raw older source moments supply context only; residual SD/correlation are not recoverable from them. Unit variance follows multiplying normal vectors by sqrt((df-2)/ChiSquare(df)).

selection.derivation: Domain limits from task eligibility plus assumed positive pulse pressure; rejection rather than clipping.

max_rejection_rounds.derivation: Finite computation limit; fail visibly if exceeded.
